items.title: Live: Big tech faces higher tax if it does not reach deals with local publishers
items.description: Tech companies will be forced to pay a 2.5 per cent tax on digital advertising revenue if they do not reach deals with media companies. Follow live.

items.title: In a remote community, a boy asked me a question no child should
items.description: In the tiny community of Baniyala, in East Arnhem Land, I sat next to a 13-year-old boy who asked me a question no child should be asking.

items.title: Two firefighting helicopters collide midair fighting blazes in Greece
items.description: Two firefighters are dead after a collision between two helicopters near Athens, as Europe's wildfire emergency continues.

items.title: Global shockwaves as South Korea's crash rattles markets
items.description: Balance is a fundamental principle of everyday life on the Korean peninsula, but the worst stock market crash in the nation's history threatens the livelihood of millions.

items.title: Child labour in the chocolate industry is still happening. These videos prove it
items.description: For decades, major chocolate companies have pledged to eradicate child labour. Four Corners discovered that in Ghana, the promises don't always match the reality.

items.title: Iranians say the regime is at war 'with its own people'
items.description: Three Iranians have shared their insights on life under the regime, as the war passes its fifth month and US President Donald Trump threatens a return to all-out fighting if no long-term peace deal can be struck.

items.title: Safety concerns for ex-ASIO agent as he seeks visa to testify
items.description: It is the former agent's second bid to enter Australia after his first visa was rejected because immigration authorities feared he was unlikely to leave.

items.title: Housing market seeing 'rapid deterioration' as downturn deepens
items.description: Australia's housing downturn is spreading across the country, with the latest property price data showing previously resilient markets that had recently set record-high prices are now experiencing a decline in values.

items.title: Live: Delta belts out Aussie classic in stunning closing ceremony performance
items.description: Australia finishes the 2026 Commonwealth Games with an eye-watering 70 golds, as track cyclist Georgia Baker is announced as the nation's flag bearer for the closing ceremony later this morning. Follow live.

items.title: Trump holds off on new strikes against Iran amid emerging 'deal'
items.description: Donald Trump says the US will hold off on fresh strikes against Iran, as Middle East allies have agreed to parameters of a deal to end the war.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
